pdf.source: Direct PDF path and transparency operators from projected/clipped SVG geometry, no SVG screenshot or bitmap conversion

color_export.color_space: ICCBased CMYK; profile embedded in PDF; no PDF/X output intent or certification
color_export.ink_scope: Maximum sum of one converted paint color; not a separation/overprint or overlapping-transparency coverage audit.

notes: Physical page size retained; print at 100% when dimensions matter.
No automatic bleed, crop marks, imposition, trapping or PDF/X certification.
Live vector transparency retained; appearance can change with the blending color space.
The selected profile defines the output condition; its suitability for the actual paper/press is not inferred. No profile is distributed with the tool.
